title: Human-approved EEA1 evidence and draft acceptance-criteria update
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's instruction to proceed with the prioritized OpenFS work. Add source-backed E-Wave measurements, define a common EEA1 acceptance-test protocol, and publish application-specific draft acceptance criteria without inventing pass/fail values. Keep application-owner approval, independent validation, and Consensus incomplete. Do not use the drafts for procurement decisions. Validate, push, and create a bilingual reviewable pull request. Do not merge or deploy production GitHub Pages without a separate explicit instruction.
